title: Canonical ordinary origin comparison arrows
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $P=\mathbf P^1_S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], $X=\mathbf A^1_S$ [def-sbc-affine-space], $j:X\to P$ the chart $[1:t]$, $i:S\to X$ its zero section and $\bar i=ji$. For a commutative ring $A$, work in the ordinary small-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], using ordinary inverse and direct image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and exact extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Define the restriction map $j^{-1}\bar i_*A\to i_*A$ by the canonical closed exchange with identity on $S$ [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. For its normalized isomorphism $r$, define $e:j_!i_*A\to\bar i_*A$ by the actual sheaf counit after $j_!(r^{-1})$, then exact localization with its single-object comparison [def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction]. For $NA=0$ and the roots/pure-tensor normalized finite twist transport [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], define $\epsilon:j_!L_X[2]\to L_P[2]$ by the actual sheaf counit after the inverse twist comparison, exact localization and its shift comparison. Define $R\Gamma_c(X,-)=R\Gamma(P,j_!-)$ in this specified compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and the constant-section unit $A[0]\to R\Gamma(P,A_P)$ by the original constant-sheaf/global-sections derived adjunction. A supported Ext class is realized by the existing Ext-to-derived-Hom equivalence. Finally package, for these actual arrows, the equations that $e$ is invertible, $j_!c_X;\epsilon=e;c_P$, $u;c_P=c_1$, $\lambda;R\Gamma(e)=\eta;R\Gamma(u)$ and $\lambda;R\Gamma_c(c_X);R\Gamma(\epsilon)=\eta;R\Gamma(c_1)$, where $u:A_P\to\bar i_*A$ is the closed unit and $\lambda:A[0]\simeq R\Gamma_c(X,i_*A)$. The package is a predicate containing these equations, not an assertion that they hold.
